name: unreal_forums_jobs-deals-mcp
display_name: Unreal Engine Forums — Job Offerings MCP
description: Unreal Engine Forums — Job Offerings (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a doc

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /search.json?q=<query> category:76 order:latest&page=<page> (Discourse 'Search for a term'), restricted to the Got Skills? Looking for Talent? › Job Offerings ('Post your open positions here!') category (id 76) and newest first. `query` is REQUIRED in practice: without it no q is sent and Discourse returns no topics. Discourse search takes at least 3 characters and supports its advanced filters inside the query (e.g. tags:scripter, after:2026-09-01). category and min_budget are not sent (no budget field on forum topics). Pages hold up to 50 topics (limit is not sent). title/posted_at are the topic's; description is the search excerpt; the topic URL is https://forums.unrealengine.com/t/<id>. Posters are matched in the response's separate posts[] list (raw is per topic), so buyer is null here — use get_posting.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET /t/{id}.json ('Get a single topic'): buyer = the topic creator's username, description = the first post's HTML (post_stream.posts[0].cooked); tags are {id, name, slug} objects on this forum and stay in raw.tags. The topic URL is https://forums.unrealengine.com/t/<id>.
